scope: Combining a tandem affinity purification approach and mass spectrometry, we identified stromal cell–derived factor 2 (SDF2) as a component of the eNOS macromolecular complex in endothelial cells.
The central goal of this study was to identify activation-state eNOS-interacting partners using a proteomic strategy of tandem affinity purification (TAP) followed by mass spectrometry (MS).
